suread: review R1 素读（只读 text/，未开 md）

facts.fact: 电话派 Benny-G 与 Javier 赶鳄
facts.anchor: assigning him and Javier to alligator-herding duty

facts.fact: 给 Gazzie 发短信后静音手机
Gazzie 二楼阳台俯身喊她
facts.anchor: She was watching me from the second-floor veranda, hands gripping the railing.

facts.fact: 先洗脸再从窗口进阳台
facts.anchor: Then I opened my window to the veranda and stepped through.

facts.fact: 呵斥别管幼鳄、本周不喂
facts.anchor: She doesn’t need anything to eat this week.

facts.fact: 谎称有人开了繁殖池闸门
facts.anchor: Someone opened the gate to the breeding pond

facts.fact: 内心认定巨大失败、须抖出 Harrison 背叛
facts.anchor: It had been a colossal failure on my part

facts.fact: Gazzie 称多数鳄会滞留蓄水塘可捞回
谎称 Harrison 应该还在农场
facts.anchor: “I think he’s still at the farm.” Not exactly a lie.

facts.fact: 盗猎者偷两百枚蛋、Ironheart 协助、献更大祭
盗猎者翻车、法律完好归还蛋
facts.anchor: The law returned the eggs to us. In perfect condition, each one.

facts.fact: 两盗猎者一断腿一被压死
facts.anchor: One lost a leg in the crash, and the other was crushed. Died.

facts.fact: 狩猎定在周五（原周六晚会后、怕雨）
要求参加狩猎并宣布继承权
facts.anchor: I’ll announce your inheritance at the party.

facts.fact: 浴室门玻璃上看到更白、黑眼的脸
认定 Ida 强求这场狩猎
facts.anchor: Ida wanted this hunt. She was insisting on it.

facts.fact: 被迫答应周五、太阳穴痛消退
facts.anchor: Instantly, the pain in my temples relented. Ida was satisfied.

facts.fact: 淋浴搓红皮肤、盯镜防曾祖母
facts.anchor: I scrubbed my skin raw, eyes fixed on the bathroom mirror

relations: 我↔Gazzie：继承权由她宣布、怕她不容错
I’ll announce your inheritance at the party.
我↔Harrison：打了且享受其痛、须磨说辞
how I’d struck him. Enjoyed his pain.
numbers: 狩猎原定周六晚会后、改周五
小鳄每几周一喂、大鳄可一年不食
